newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL buys Amoco 's Romanian stations.
newsitem.headline: MOL buys Amoco 's Romanian stations.

text.p: Hungary's oil and gas company MOL Rt said on Friday it had bought purchased Amoco Oil Holding Company 's Romanian retail operations.
"MOL has acquired 12 sites from Amoco, out of which construction at three sites is already underway and eight sites are located in Bucharest," MOL said in a statement.
MOL's expansion into the Romanian retail petroleum market is part of its expansion strategy across the region aiming to develop 100 to 150 retail sites over the next five years, MOL said.
Amoco's move to sell its Romanian retail operations is part of the review of the U.S. company's global retail strategy, the statement said.
It also said that negotiations for the sale of Amoco's petroleum product business in Poland and Bulgaria are continuing.
However, a MOL source told Reuters MOL was not involved in these negotiations as its expansion primarily targets the neighbouring countries.
On Thursday, MOL shares closed at 3,000 forints, up 30 on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
